Bandizip_PluginDesc: Bandizip integration plugin. Lets Lertaro fill in the destination path in Bandizip's extract dialog and its add-files dialog (e.g. from the Quick Navigation menu).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BandizipExtractDialogAd: Recognize Bandizip’s extraction dialog by its controls and fill the destination path in any interface language.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BandizipAddFilesDialogA: Recognize Bandizip’s Add Files dialog by its controls and navigate to the target folder in any interface language.
